column1: Name (This field is mandatory, give this risk a descriptive title.)
column2: Description (Optional, describe this risk scenario, context, triggers, Etc.)
column3: Risk GRC Contact (Mandatory. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|" with a mandatory prefix. For example: Group-Admin|User-John). You can get the login of an user account from Settings / Organization & Access / Users or name of a group from Settings / Organization & Access / Groups.)
column4: Risk Originator Contact (Mandatory. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|" with a mandatory prefix. For example: Group-Admin|User-John). You can get the login of an user account from Settings / Organization & Access / Users or name of a group from Settings / Organization & Access / Groups.)
column5: Tags (Optional and accepts tags separated by "|". For example "Critical|High Risk|Financial Risk")
column6: Next Review Date (This field is mandatory, define a date when this risk will be reviewed, the format for the date is YYYY-MM-DD and the date must be in the future.)
column7: Related Assets (This field is mandatory, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of an asset, you can find them at Asset Management / Asset Identification.)
column8: Threat Tags (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a threat, you can find them at Risk Management / Asset Risk Management / Settings / Threats.)
column9: Threat Description (Optional, describe the context of the threats vectors for this risk.)
column10: Vulnerabilities Tags (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a vulnerability, you can find them at Risk Management / Asset Risk Management / Settings / Vulnerabilities.)
column11: Vulnerabilities Description (Optional, describe the context of the vulnerabilities vectors for this risk.)
column12: Likelihood (Analysis) (This field is mandatory, enter one from the following options: 1 for Likelihood (Very Low), 2 for Likelihood (Low), 3 for Likelihood (Medium), 4 for Likelihood (High), 5 for Likelihood (Very High))
column13: Impact (Analysis) (This field is mandatory, enter one from the following options: 6 for Impact (Negligible), 7 for Impact (Minor), 8 for Impact (Moderate), 9 for Impact (Major), 10 for Impact (Critical))
column14: Risk Treatment (This field is mandatory, select id of treatment strategy for this risk, can be one of the following values: 1 for Accept, 2 for Avoid, 3 for Mitigate, 4 for Transfer)
column15: Treatment: Internal Controls (Mandatory / optional depends on "Risk Treatment" input and settings of treatment options, you can find them in risk section settings under Treatment Options. Accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a control, you can find them at Control Catalog / Internal Controls.)
column16: Treatment: Policies (Mandatory / optional depends on "Risk Treatment" input and settings of treatment options, you can find them in risk section settings under Treatment Options. Accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a policy, you can find them at Control Catalog / Policies.)
column17: Treatment: Risk Exceptions (Mandatory / optional depends on "Risk Treatment" input and settings of treatment options, you can find them in risk section settings under Treatment Options. Accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of an exception, you can find them at Risk Management / Risk Exceptions.)
column18: Treatment: Projects (Mandatory / optional depends on "Risk Treatment" input and settings of treatment options, you can find them in risk section settings under Treatment Options. Accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a project, you can find them at Security Operations / Project Management.)
